ValidationRule.description: "Scheduled day for blocking" is filled when Employee Status = "to be deactivated"
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($User.ER_BypassVR__c), ISPICKVAL(ER_Employee_Status__c,'To be deactivated'), ISBLANK( ERFI_Scheduled_day_for_blocking__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You need to inform the Scheduled day for blocking
